00069 void DecayUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00070 {
00071  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00072  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00073  float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00074  float* decaySamples = inputs[DecayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00075  float newDecayTime = *decaySamples;
00076  
00077  ugen_assert(newDecayTime >= 0.f);
00078  
00079  if(newDecayTime != currentDecayTime)
00080  {
00081   float next_b1 = newDecayTime == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 / (newDecayTime * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00082   float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor();
00083   currentDecayTime = newDecayTime;
00084   
00085   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00086   {
00087    float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00088    *outputSamples++ = y1 = y0 + b1 * y1;
00089    b1 += b1_slope;
00090   }
00091  }
00092  else
00093  {
00094   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00095   {
00096    float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00097    *outputSamples++ = y1 = y0 + b1 * y1;
00098   }
00099  }
00100  
00101  y1 = zap(y1); // denormal!
00102 }

00111 void DecayUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00112 {
00113  const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00114  unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00115  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00116  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00117  float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00118  float* decaySamples = inputs[DecayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00119  float newDecayTime = *decaySamples;
00120  
00121  ugen_assert(newDecayTime >= 0.f);
00122  
00123  int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00124  
00125  if(newDecayTime != currentDecayTime)
00126  {
00127   float next_b1 = newDecayTime == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 * krBlockSize / (newDecayTime * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00128   float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor() * krBlockSize;
00129   currentDecayTime = newDecayTime;
00130     
00131   while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00132   {
00133    float nextValue = value;
00134    if(numKrSamples == 0)   
00135    {
00136     b1 += b1_slope;
00137     float y0 = *inputSamples; 
00138     nextValue = y1 = y0 + b1 * y1;
00139    }
00140    
00141    numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00142    
00143    blockPosition  += numKrSamples;
00144    inputSamples  += numKrSamples;
00145    
00146    if(nextValue == value)
00147    {
00148     while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00149     {
00150      *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00151      --numSamplesToProcess;
00152      --numKrSamples;
00153     }
00154    } 
00155    else
00156    {
00157     float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00158     
00159     while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00160     {
00161      *outputSamples++ = value;
00162      value += valueSlope;
00163      --numSamplesToProcess;
00164      --numKrSamples;
00165     }
00166     
00167     value = nextValue;
00168    }
00169   }
00170   
00171   b1 = next_b1;
00172   
00173  }
00174  else
00175  {
00176   while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00177   {
00178    float nextValue = value;
00179    if(numKrSamples == 0)   
00180    {
00181     float y0 = *inputSamples; 
00182     nextValue = y1 = y0 + b1 * y1;
00183    }
00184    
00185    numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00186    
00187    blockPosition  += numKrSamples;
00188    inputSamples  += numKrSamples;
00189    
00190    if(nextValue == value)
00191    {
00192     while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00193     {
00194      *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00195      --numSamplesToProcess;
00196      --numKrSamples;
00197     }
00198    } 
00199    else
00200    {
00201     float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00202     
00203     while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00204     {
00205      *outputSamples++ = value;
00206      value += valueSlope;
00207      --numSamplesToProcess;
00208      --numKrSamples;
00209     }
00210     
00211     value = nextValue;
00212    }
00213   }
00214  }
00215  
00216  y1 = zap(y1);
00217 }

00219 Decay::Decay(UGen const& input, UGen const& decayTime) throw()
00220 {
00221  UGen inputs[] = { input, decayTime };
00222  const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputChannels(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);  
00223  initInternal(numInputChannels);
00224  
00225  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00226  {
00227   internalUGens[i] = new DecayUGenInternal(input, decayTime);
00228   internalUGens[i]->initValue(input.getValue(i));
00229  }
